claims.claim: Measure and normalize integrated loudness with a two-pass EBU R128/BS.1770 workflow.
claims.basis: FFmpeg loudnorm, EBU R128, ITU-R BS.1770

claims.claim: Normal usage is browser-local and does not require upload or a server roundtrip.
LUFS normalization is two-pass and follows FFmpeg loudnorm behavior; output encoding can slightly alter measured values.
EBU R 128 v5 recommends programme loudness normalization around -23 LUFS; the tool also offers common non-broadcast targets with clear labeling.
